issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): The problem statement UML (class Lecture) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type double, while the solution implementation defines public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). The template only contains a TODO for this method (no signature). This inconsistency between the UML/specification (double) and the solution implementation (int) can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to mismatched implementations or failing tests if an exercise grader expects a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent with the UML/specification. Update the solution method to return a double and perform floating-point division, for example: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } Alternatively, if integer division is intended, update the UML and problem text to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int so all artifacts agree.
